name: typesafe
title: TypeSafe (Jev)
what: Asks TypeSafe System One (Jev) about log lines the rules cannot settle, before the keyword fallback.
about: An AI classifier for what the rules cannot settle. Without it, a keyword fallback decides.

settings.prompt: TypeSafe (Jev) API key, blank to use rules only
Seconds one Jev call may take
Seconds of Jev calls per batch of events (the rest use the fallback)
Jev answers kept per log template (0 turns the cache off)
Seconds a kept Jev answer is used
